The '''Tangrene''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that evolved on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tangrene]]. The species developed a peaceful, nomadic society that lived on a world with very little surface vegetation. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was discovered between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000]] and [[3000 BBY]], and was the terminus of a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Tangrene were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in order to construct an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] center. Following completion of the project, the local [[Unidentified Moff (Morshdine sector)|Imperial Moff]] ordered the [[Speciecide|genocide]] of the Tangrene to prevent any future uprisings.

==Society and culture==
The Tangrene were a peaceful, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]], with barely any surface vegetation or moisture. Instead, [[lake]]s formed in underground caverns, around which developed [[Fungus/Legends|fungal]] and [[Plant/Legends|vegetative]] ecosystems. In response to their environment, the Tangrene developed into a nomadic society.<ref name="DFRSB" />

==History==
[[File:Planet02-SWR.png|thumb|right|The Tangrene homeworld]]
The Tangrene people evolved on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tangrene|same name]],<ref name="DFRSB" /> located within a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that was explored during the period from [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000]] to [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Tangrene system/Legends|Tangrene system]] was incorporated as part of the [[Morshdine sector/Legends|Morshdine sector]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and became the end point of a sizable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the central [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Tangrene was within contested territory.<ref name="Atlas" />

During the regime of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the successor state to the Republic, the Tangrene were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Empire and pressganged into constructing a defensive complex of [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] of what eventually became a highly secure [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] center. Once construction was complete, the Morshdine [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Unidentified Moff (Morshdine sector)|Imperial Moff]] elected to forestall any chance of rebellion by [[Speciecide|depopulating]] the planet. The Tangrene were completely defenseless in the face of Imperial might, and the entire Tangrene population was massacred.<ref name="DFRSB" /> After their extinction, the Tangrene homeworld was the site of [[Raid on Tangrene|several]] [[Battle of Tangrene|battles]] between various factions of the Galactic Empire and its rival, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tangrene were created by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]], author of the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1994]]. The [[West End Games]] product was created as a companion to the [[Timothy Zahn]] novel ''[[The Last Command]]''.<ref name="DFRSB" />
